summary: Payment check ledger and one forbidden probe per run; Batch A round-2 overrides scope classification: mixed ok/403 clears denied ever_ok, ambiguous prior successes verify one unwalked ever-ok peer within budget. reason: Round 8 made 403 non-durable, which re-spent the payments allowance on every run, starved good receipts behind persistent 403s and exited 7 forever. Only 404 and 403 are persisted; 5xx and transport errors still record nothing.
